note: RV park on the upland in Theodosia, just off US 160 and about 1 km by road from the Bull Shoals Lake ramp and marina: open, level gravel pads with patios in tight rows, a pool, pickleball court and a storage yard. Largely an annual-site park (many rigs stay parked through winter) that also sells nights by phone. The lake is not in view from the sites. --Claude
summary: Operator pages read: $40 a night full hookup (unchanged), 85 sites at 30/50 A, open year-round, booked by phone only, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi. Mostly an annual-site park ($1,700 a year) but it posts a nightly rate and phone and passes the five long-stay tests; stays. Not waterfront stands - the operator's 'bluff overlooking Bull Shoals Lake' is not borne out on imagery. Phone and website match. Google rating not re-read.
flags: LONG-STAY TESTS - PASSES, stays: (1) price $40, under the gate (no gateway within 40 km, none needed); (2) a nightly rate on its own site with a phone, no application, lease or membership wording ('A list of all park rules will be sent with your payment receipt'); (3) no minimum stay stated; (4) no nightly/annual split is published - on the winter leaf-off frame about 35-40 rigs stand on roughly 75-85 pads, several with roofs or decks built over them along the south row, so something under half the park looks permanently set up and half the pads are empty; (5) not a home community (two rental cabins, no lots or homes for sale). The annual rate, $1,700 with electric extra, and a home-page review 'Starting our first season' say what it mostly is; the note now says so.

WATERFRONT - contrary operator claim checked, not waterfront stands: the home page says the park is 'located on a bluff overlooking Bull Shoals Lake' and lists 'Bull Shoals Lake Access'; the rates page says 'a short drive to beautiful Bull Shoals Lake'. On imagery the pads sit on a flat upland bench; the nearest water is the lake arm about 650 m south-east, beyond a field and continuous timber, and the park is ringed by storage buildings and woods. No pad has a line of sight to water. Lake access is the Corps ramp 1 km away (Theodosia Park, 1892).
BOOKING: phone only; nothing on the site sells a night online. Presence passes on the working site with a phone.
GOOGLE: not re-read this pass (no browser run); stored evidence is 4.7 over 35 from 2026-10-03.
PIN: stored 36.5795,-92.6629 is in the middle of the pad rows. No move.

RIG FIT: pads on imagery are 15-20 m long gravel back-ins; no length limit is published.
